description: This file defines an interface named LoanJournalEntryPoster that declares methods for posting journal entries related to loan transactions and external owner transfers within the Financer project. It is part of the loan account service layer and specifies methods to create journal entries immediately for various loan-related events.

classes.name: LoanJournalEntryPoster
classes.description: An interface for posting journal entries for loan transactions and owner transfers.

methods.name: postJournalEntriesForLoanTransaction
methods.description: Creates journal entries immediately for a given loan transaction, replacing a multi-step process.

methods.name: postJournalEntriesForExternalOwnerTransfer
methods.description: Creates journal entries immediately for an external owner transfer of a loan.
